business_summary: Fuva Brain Limited provides cyber security solutions in Japan. The company offers gateway network security products comprising Eye 247 safety zone USAVVI and FSAVVI, which are multi-layered security products; ASH series, which prevents the spread of infection and secondary damage in the event of a virus infection; Unoerva SecureSphere; Imperva App Earth; Cato SASE platform, which integrates SD-WAN and security into a single cloud service; Network Blackbox, an NDR product; Eye 247  Spam Shield, an email security service; Reboot Guard, a self-contained operation solution; and DualLink Guard, a WAN line backup system, as well as endpoint security products, including Crystal Protection, an endpoint security software. It also provides human security products consisting of Eye 247 Work Smart cloud, a business process visualization tool; Eye 247 Work Smart Server Enterprise III; FB SATMail, a targeted attack email training service; FB SATDoc for vulnerability and security assessment services; FB SATSchool for communication skills and cybersecurity training; FBSATRep., a web reputation management service; and DZ Pass, a PC-based identity verification service, as well as L3to7 Auto-Response, a security integration product; and Secure X-Ray, a security diagnostic service. In addition, the company offers security and work style reform IT tools; implementation, and operational and maintenance support; contract development and system engineering; recruitment support and consulting; paid employment and talent placement; internet advertising agency services; education and training seminars; and system software and hardware products. Further, it engages in IT personnel dispatch and outsourcing; web content; internet research systems; and M&A and investment activities. The company was formerly known as Ahkun Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Fuva Brain Limited in October 2018. Fuva Brain Limited was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
